story_so_far: Day 1: Hamid (Lahore) got 82% in 12th but the university fee is Rs 2,00,000 a year; he tore the admission form and wrote PLAN B. Day 2: first job at a chai dhaba, 12 hours; burned hand, broke a cup, paid Rs 450 (Rs 1,200). Bilal arrived with a 'paise double' scheme. Day 3: Bilal's scheme - they each put Rs 1,000 into 10 'cheap' phones at the bazaar; at home all were plastic dummies. Angry at first, then they laughed together on the rooftop. Rs 200 left. Diary: 'Aaj bhi bach gaye. Kal: teen naukriyan!' Day 4 (Teen Naukriyan): 5 AM newspaper round on an old cycle - chain broke, finished 40 houses on foot chased by a dog (+Rs 150); late to the dhaba, Rs 100 cut (+Rs 350); night tuition for Ali (Class 5) - fell asleep, Ali's ammi caught him, but Ali said 'sir taught best today', she paid Rs 300 and said 'kal bhi aana'. Rs 1,000. Cliffhanger: an unknown number calls about a delivery job - battery 1%, phone dies. Day 5 (Phone Mar Gaya): phone dead; charger plugged in - loadshedding; Bilal had sold his charger (scheme #2); paid Rs 50 at a generator mobile shop, but balance zero; a kind stranger (Chacha, white topi + beard) lent his phone. Job confirmed: delivery rider, Rs 25,000/month - in KARACHI, day after tomorrow 9 AM. Bus ticket Rs 1,500 vs Rs 950 in pocket (Rs 550 short). Cliffhanger: Ammi overheard - 'Karachi? Tum Karachi ja rahe ho?' Day 6 (Station Ki Raat): Ammi said 'Koi Karachi nahi jayega!'; Hamid: Rs 25,000/month, Abbu ki dawai. Sold his old broken cycle to a kabadi for only Rs 300 (still Rs 250 short). At 1 AM Ammi gave him a potli: her savings Rs 400 + 6 parathay ('roz phone karna'); Abbu said nothing, just put a hand on his head. 18-hour bus (-Rs 1,500). Karachi bus adda 2 AM: chai Rs 30 -> Rs 120 left; a guard (blue cap, moustache) woke him off the bench ('Yahan sona mana hai!'); slept on the floor hugging his bag while a shady man eyed it; ate Ammi's cold parathay. Cliffhanger: wakes at 8:40 AM - interview at 9 AM, address 25 km away, rickshaw Rs 400, jeb Rs 120. Day 7 (Kiraye Ki Bike): rickshaw wanted Rs 400 (kam nahi hoga); rented a 70cc bike from Chacha Ghafoor (GHAFOOR BIKE CENTER, Rs 100/din, 'brake ki koi guarantee nahi') -> Rs 20. Traffic jam at 8:50, gali shortcut blocked by a bhains ('Sorry bhains ji'), downhill the brakes failed - crashed into cardboard boxes at the TEZ DELIVERY head office gate exactly at 9:00. The manager (blue shirt, red tie, clipboard) laughed: 'bike toh chala lete ho, test do' - first order in 30 min without brakes (chappal as brake). Ammi's voice note mid-ride ('pohanch gaye beta? nashta kiya?'). Lift kharab, 5 floors on foot; delivered with 01:12 left: first 5-star rating + Rs 50 tip -> Rs 70. NAUKRI PAKKI. Cliffhanger: back at Ghafoor's at night, he finds the dent - 'Yeh dent kis ne daala? Paanch sau nikaalo!' Jurmana Rs 500 vs jeb Rs 70. Day 8 (Barish): Ghafoor deal - dent fine paid as Rs 50/day qist + Rs 100 daily kiraya. Big order: 3 kg birthday cake, 25 min. Karachi monsoon: thunder, road became a river, engine died, his chappal floated away (funny), pushed the bike 2 km; Ammi's voice note 'bahar mat nikalna!'. Opened the box under an awning - cake melted (Rs 1,200, 'paise katenge?'). At FLAT 2-A, Master Saleem (retired teacher, white curly hair, gold glasses, maroon vest; 'Best Teacher 1998') said 'cake chhoro, tum bheeg gaye ho', gave chai + towel, asked 'parhte kyun nahi?' - '82% thay sir, fees nahi thi.' Said 'mithaas wohi hai', gave 5 stars + Rs 200 tip and a chit. Paid Ghafoor Rs 150 -> Rs 120; jurmana baaki Rs 450. Cliffhanger: chit says 'Kal subah 8 baje aana, ek imtihaan hai - M. Saleem', and the manager texts 'Kal 8 baje duty. Late = naukri khatam.' Dono 8 baje!
